test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

The house is cleaned by her every morning before breakfast.

options.text: She is cleaning the house every morning before breakfast.
She had been cleaning the house every morning before breakfast.
She cleans the house every morning before breakfast.
She has cleaned the house every morning before breakfast.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: "The house is cleaned by her every morning before breakfast."
 
• To convert to active voice, the subject performing the action ("her") comes first.
 
• The object of the passive sentence ("the house") follows the subject.
 
• The verb form is adjusted from passive present simple ("is cleaned") to active present simple ("cleans").
 
• The time phrase "every morning before breakfast" remains at the end.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *She cleans the house every morning before breakfast.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** She is cleaning the house every morning before breakfast. – Incorrect tense (present continuous) instead of simple present.
 
• **Option 2:** She had been cleaning the house every morning before breakfast. – Incorrect tense (past perfect continuous).
 
• **Option 4:** She has cleaned the house every morning before breakfast. – Incorrect tense (present perfect) which does not match the passive present simple.
